message:
release(0.2.116): the first release with both halves of the update

0.2.115 carried the orphan fix and a client with no button. This one has the notice
and something to press.

One more line goes with it. The server address field suggested http://주소:8080, and
the update path refuses http at two layers -- so the example was an instruction to
type the one address that silently turns updates off. This machine's saved value has
exactly that shape, which is why every check it ever logged said "not configured".
The placeholder now shows https. Nothing else: no address validation, no forced
upgrade of what is already saved.

Five artifacts changed, ui/shell.html among them, 12648 -> 15483. Both gates pass and
the served document was fetched back and re-verified byte for byte; all ten public
URLs were downloaded anonymously and hashed. 0.2.115's artifacts were compared on the
server and are unchanged, and the dist installer was compared against the bytes the
public URL actually serves rather than against the staging copy.

What this release still cannot claim: that a live check produces the notice. That
needs an account and a network. Delivery is a manual install -- sending a button
through the update path would need the button.
